title: Equality of diagonal languages
statement: For every function $g:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, the language of bit strings $x$ for which the diagonal simulation machine does not halt within the specified time $g(|x|)$ with output equal to the one-bit string $1$ is equal to the language of bit strings $x$ for which the diagonal simulation does not halt within that time with that output.
replaced:
For every function $g:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, the language of words $x$ for which the
diagonal simulation does not halt at time $g(|x|)$ with output the single bit $1$ equals
the language of words $x$ for which the diagonal simulation machine does not halt at
that time with that output.
